provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: n=length(d) is the larger snapshot dimension; assumes columns exceed rows.
audit_member_text: length(d) at L7 selects the largest matrix dimension rather than explicitly the second-row width; an input with more rows than columns makes d1(i) exceed its column count.

base_member_text: Five snapshots produce 6 data columns, but the output keeps the BP1_SHAPE filename used by the 7-snapshot analytical variant -- downstream consumers expecting 8 columns would mismatch; snapshot indices 0095..0219 map to benchmark times externally.
Row 2 of each 2D snapshot used as profile; x re-indexing via kk relies on the kept window being contiguous (monotonic x) -- same caveats as the _ana variant.

audit_member_text: Cross-file range defect across L7-L16 and L32-L36: n is taken only from eta_0095, but the same index i is applied to d1-d5 without checking that every loaded matrix has at least two rows and n columns; any shorter or differently shaped file causes out-of-range indexing.

Empty-selection defect across L26-L46: if no generated x lies in [-2,20], kk and data are never assigned, yet the later coordinate loop/output still uses data, causing an undefined-variable failure rather than an empty result.
The script overwrites d for each load and never checks that all five snapshots share the same spatial grid, so equal lengths with different grids silently produce misregistered columns.
